title: Artifact Lifecycle Lab: Replication Package for Measuring Mechanical Reference Integrity in Machine-Consumed Instruction Files
description:
Archival replication package for the ACM TOSEM submission Measuring Mechanical Reference Integrity in Machine-Consumed Instruction Files.

Frozen scientific outputs (2026-07-03) include longitudinal panel exports (RQ1–RQ4), confirmatory audits (RQ2 failure audit; born-stale / GFC), exploratory RQ5 A/B/C ledgers, claim-to-evidence mapping, protocols, and Makefile regeneration targets for observational analyses.

v1.1.0 adds a validation extension on those frozen exports: blinded RQ2 second-auditor package with independent human labels (Pepe/Ana/Rebeca), recommended multi-estimator agreement summaries, audit-rule sensitivity, and repository-concentration analyses. Do not silently replace v1.0.0.

Authors: César Andrés (corresponding); David Martín-Moncunill.

Primary entry point: REPLICATION.md. Authoritative claim inventory: docs/SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE_FREEZE.md. Validation protocol: docs/VALIDATION_EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md.

Zenodo version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21716211 (v1.1.0). Prior freeze: 10.5281/zenodo.21711432 (v1.0.0). Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21711431.

RQ5 agent reruns require Claude Code CLI credentials and are frozen; use committed ledgers for manuscript numbers.
